news.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction Release Date Confirmed
news.summary: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction has a release date: February 4, 2027.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/unnamed-5-1791812244961.png
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction has a release date: February 4, 2027.

Bitmap Bureau, the developer behind Terminator 2D: No Fate, worked with Mattel and the retro team at Clear River Games on the old-school brawler, which launches digitally and physically on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Two physical versions of the game will be available via Limited Run Games. The standard physical release costs $29.99, and the Collector’s Edition costs $99.99.

Dragon Pearl of Destruction is inspired by the much-loved ‘80s animated series, and you can see that come through in pixel-art and 2D gameplay. The playable characters are He-Man, She-Ra, Man-At-Arms, and Teela, and you can play solo or co-op (two-player local co-op).

There are 13 stages, including the Royal Palace, the Vine Jungle, and Snake Mountain, and famous villains such as Skeletor, Evil-Lyn, Beast Man, and Trap Jaw. You’ll also bump into the dark sorceress Shokoti and the Shadow Beasts.

The Collector’s Edition includes lunchbox style packaging, pin badges, a mini-power sword, and an acrylic standee featuring He-Man riding Battle Cat, among other things. The contents of both physical editions are detailed below.
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction Standard Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/unnamed-4-1791812195013.png
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction Collector’s Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/unnamed-3-1791812195014.png

We previewed He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction in August and thought it could be the first ever good He-Man game. It comes following the release of Amazon’s Masters of the Universe, which struggled at the box office but found success on Prime Video.

news.title: GS仅6分 拿破仑第一人称类魂武器挺多但敌人重复
news.summary: GameSpot为第一人称类魂游戏《不朽遗志》打出6分

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122129072784.png
GameSpot为第一人称类魂游戏《不朽遗志》打出6分（Fair）。评测认为，这款游戏试图在类魂框架中塞入太多东西，反而削弱了本可以更出色的核心体验。主角威廉·道塞特从战场复活，发现欧洲已被腐败力量侵蚀，他要寻找失散的战友并弄清战争为何变成这样。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122129168246.png
游戏最大的亮点是第一人称近战与弹反。快速、灵敏的挥砍和精准弹反带来不错的爽感，处决动作也随武器变化。同时，游戏加入了火枪、魔法和墙壁奔跑等能力，每种武器都有独立升级树。但问题在于：敌人种类太少，从头到尾反复面对同样的步兵和狗，死亡后的检查点又过于宽容，紧张感被大幅稀释。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122129174737.png
故事方面，威廉的救赎线被评测形容为“空洞且无趣”，配角也缺乏存在感。真正打动人的是一些短小的环境叙事——通过残影片段展现平民在战争中的绝望与牺牲。整体来看，《不朽遗志》有不错的战斗底子，但被过多的系统和缓慢的开局拖累，最终体验褒贬参半。
优点
以弹反为核心、快速利落的战斗，配合令人满意的处决动作
短小却引人入胜的故事，有效传达大规模战争带来的绝望与牺牲
缺点
大量时间浪费在教你各种武器和能力上，而这些对实际游玩体验并无实质性影响
敌人种类有限，检查点又过于宽容，削弱了难度，也缓解了死亡带来的紧张感
威廉的救赎故事空洞无趣，寥寥几个配角也毫无存在感

news.title: 网购买狗仅退款后狗人间蒸发！商家怒奔600公里讨还
news.summary: 消费者8000元网购西高地犬后申请仅退款，商家驱车600公里跨省讨狗，双方各执一词。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122118369876.png
据九派新闻10月9日报道，山西晋中一消费者今年8月在宠物店下单，购买一只五个月大、疫苗齐全、价格8000元的西高地犬，约六天后反映狗狗生病感冒，随后申请退货退款。宠物店老板娘杜女士介绍，犬只患犬瘟、细小两种高致死率传染病才在退货范围内，为接回小狗，她同意了对方的“仅退款”申请，平台随即结束订单。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122122302436.jpg
平台聊天记录显示，8月25日上午商家司机已到当地接狗，商家提出同意退款，运费360元、打包费检测费180元共计540元由客户承担。杜女士称，没想到钱退了对方却不还狗，她得知后情绪激动，随后报了警。顾客刘先生（化姓）则解释，运费没有商量好商家就让物流来接狗，他担心狗被取走后拿不到退款，因此拒绝交狗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122124556379.png
为讨回小狗，10月7日杜女士和丈夫从山东济宁出发，驱车约600公里抵达山西晋中某县，在刘先生小区门口守候，油费、高速费和住宿费约一千元。双方均透露，警方调解方案为刘先生赔偿三四千元，两人都不满意。杜女士表示这几天生意已暂停，“我就要小狗，不需要道歉”，若调解无果打算起诉；当地派出所10月9日回应称此事正在处理。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122126548728.png
刘先生称自己并非恶意仅退款，小狗已病死，此前曾为狗洗澡并带其看过病，但截至发稿未提供诊断证明。他还表示，商家驱车上门讨要宠物狗并拍视频发到网上，对他的生活和工作造成影响，目前已找律师打算起诉宠物店。目前双方各执一词，纠纷仍在协调处理中。

news.title: Baki’s Yujiro Hanma Is About To Turn Tekken 8 Into A Full-Blown Muscle Appreciation Simulator
news.summary: Bandai Namco has dropped a new trailer for Tekken 8 , and while this one is mostly focused on everyone's favor

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/11/tekken-8-yujiro-1791734505643.png
Bandai Namco has revealed a first look at Tekken 8 DLC character Yujiro Hanma, and the Baki rep is looking just as uncanny as fans expected.

The new trailer for the fighting game's Season 3 characters debuted alongside Evo France 2026. Following Kunimitsu's release in June and Bob's release in August, kangaroo-and-joey fighter Roger Jr. is now officially set for a November 11 early access launch, with the full release following November 16, but the character most fans are looking forward to is still without a proper release date.

Roger Jr. is definitely the star of the new Tekken 8 DLC trailer, with nearly three minutes of its four-minute runtime dedicated to showing off the marsupial boxer's gameplay. The Yujiro teaser, meanwhile, is tucked at the end, but its reveals are particularly shocking. You can see how the Baki the Grappler villain has been reimagined within the world of Tekken below.

Yujiro is… expressive, to say the least, so nailing his face and bulging muscles was always going to draw attention. Well, the Bandai Namco team did their best, with today's Evo trailer showing just a few shots of his iconic toothy smile and flexibility.

It looks like work on the anime guest character is still underway, but just because there's no release date doesn't mean there isn't a plan to show more. The end of the new teaser promised that a new Yujiro trailer will premiere alongside the Tekken World Tour Finals January 17, 2027. That's three months out from now, so we can probably expect to see gameplay by that point.

Looking back at the calendar, Bandai Namco has typically had a few months of downtime between Tekken 8 DLC releases. It will have been two months since Roger Jr. was released when the Yujiro trailer is shared, meaning we can also expect a release date announcement around that time, too. If we're lucky, the Baki fighter might even drop that same day, but again, nothing regarding his release date has been confirmed quite yet.

Roger Jr. and Yujiro are both included in the Season 3 pass and will round out its promise of four bonus characters. Season 1 and Season 2 included fighters like Heihachi, Armor King, Anna, and Final Fantasy 16 protagonist Clive Rosfield. While passes cost $30 each, the Season 3 pass is currently available for $34.99.

IGN learned more about Yujiro's inclusion in Tekken 8 when speaking with producer Naoya Yasuda and director of promotions and former Baki manga editor Yuki Yokoi earlier this year. Be sure to read the full interview for insight into how and why the team decided to include a character that never loses. You can also read about how former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada influenced one of Roger Jr.'s best references , and the player who climbed through the ranks while blindfolded .

news.title: IGN 7分 拿破仑第一人称类魂新作:有创意但没执行好
news.summary: 《不朽遗志》IGN评分

content.v: 《不朽遗志》是《幽灵行者》开发商 One More Level 打造的第一人称类魂动作游戏，背景设定在一个架空的拿破仑时代：拿破仑在滑铁卢获胜，世界因此扭曲成一片诡异的战争废墟。玩家扮演亡灵战士威廉，左手寄宿着变异魔法，右手挥舞刀剑与火枪，在阴郁的战场上不断死亡、复活、战斗。游戏融合剑术、枪械、法术、跑墙平台跳跃与技能构筑，战役约 20 小时，于 2026 年 10 月 13 日发售。
简评：
《不朽遗志》是一款想法很多、执行不稳的类魂新作。第一人称剑枪法术混战、拿破仑胜利后的怪诞世界、跑墙与左手魔法都让人眼前一亮，武器、技能和“Amber”改装也提供了不错的构筑空间。但敌人 AI 呆滞、Boss 稀少且软弱、剧情空洞，加上大量崩溃和技术 Bug，让这段 20 小时的旅程起伏明显。它不够精致，却足够独特，适合愿意忍受毛病的类魂爱好者。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122119141286.png
IGN评分： 7
总评：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122119514103.png

《不朽遗志》最吸引人的地方，是它把几种看似不搭的元素硬塞进同一个框架：第一人称类魂战斗、生化奇兵式的左手魔法、拿破仑时代的架空历史，以及《泰坦陨落》般的跑墙平台跳跃。实际玩起来，这种混搭大多时候成立。近战、枪械和法术分居左右手，面对敌人时可以先点燃远处爆炸桶，再格挡冲刺的敌人，最后用手枪补刀。三把近战武器、三把枪、三种手部能力各有升级树，加上技能树和可改变玩法的 Amber 改装，构筑自由度相当可观。例如“完美主义”配合处决回血，能鼓励玩家保持满血、快速解决战斗。
关卡设计也有亮点。被摧毁的 19 世纪战场、被抬升到空中的残破舰队、毒水淹没的村庄，都比一般类魂的“毒沼”更有性格。其中一个废墟小镇只有儿童幸存，玩家需要在这些诡异孩子之间周旋，令人印象深刻。跑墙、抓钩和远程制造平台的想法也不错，可惜平台跳跃部分打磨不足，经常卡在边缘、掉出地图或穿过物体，让人扫兴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122119591395.png
问题主要集中在战斗和 Boss 设计。敌人种类偏少，AI 时常犯傻：朝空气攻击、站着挨打、攻击方向错乱；打大型敌人时还会因奇怪的隐形边界感觉像在用泡沫棒隔空敲打。Boss 更是本作短板——数量少得惊人，有些只是精英怪换皮，原创新 Boss 也大多靠夸张的前摇让玩家弹反、破体、处决，缺乏压迫感。相比之下，清杂兵反而更有乐趣。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122120189423.png
剧情方面，游戏给出一个相当普通的“战争即地狱”主题，却被各种荒诞展开削弱，比如突然在洞穴里跑到埃及打斯芬克斯。角色大多面目模糊，叙事更多是氛围而非实质。技术上，本作问题严重：硬崩溃、Steam 启动时直接关机、环境模型消失、各种 Bug 层出不穷，让原本不错的世界观体验大打折扣。
总体而言，这像是一辆装满《生化奇兵》和《黑暗之魂》二手盘的卡车撞进了游戏店——混乱、粗糙，却也足够新鲜。它远未把每个想法都执行到位，Boss 和剧情尤其令人失望，但第一人称剑术加魔法的战斗核心、怪诞的拿破仑废墟世界，以及丰富的构筑选项，仍让我愿意忍受这些毛病。如果你喜欢类魂，又想要一点不一样的东西，它值得一试。

news.title: 因为一张Steam账单，金牌讲师要被美国遣返了？
news.summary: 三年前的“金牌讲师”，被美国斩杀了吗？

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
还记得“丁胖子金牌讲师”吗？
三年前他靠着一句“又要到饭了，兄弟们”名震互联网。作为润人届的翘楚，讲师靠着一手“美式要饭”，在全网积累了百万粉丝，更有众多“荣誉”傍身。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/16592.jpg
【站在你面前的是：
加州包公、海外孤忠、
西海岸丐帮帮主、洛杉矶轮值太守
美式要饭开创者、慈禧钦点讨债人】
然而在他的“美国要饭日记”最如日中天时，他的账号却因某些原因被平台封禁，就此消失在了大众视野中。
如今尘烟散去，当我们时隔三年再次关注到讲师时，他似乎正被美国移民局遣返，而遣返他的原因是——“一张Steam充值账单”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/19792.jpg
国庆假期末，讲师发了一期名为“美国遣返”的视频。
视频里，他声称美国移民局想将他遣送回国，如果想暂缓程序，除非他把自己手中的账单送出去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/21257.jpg
根据网友的辨认，所谓的账单实际上只是Steam的充值小票，跟遣返可以说毫无关系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/25782.jpg
（可以排除的是，不是他的Steam账号被从国区遣返ORZ）
翻看其近期视频，会发现这实际已经不是他第一次被“遣返”了。而就像那种Steam小票，他被遣返的原因和逻辑千奇百怪，又是UFO又是Claude又是甜甜圈，让人摸不着头脑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/31329.jpg
从种种表象上看，经历流量大起大落的讲师，似乎“疯了”。
就像每个怀着美国梦的润人们一样，在幻想与现实的落差中，陷入了精神失常。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/36009.jpg
【此前对“美国梦”抱有终极执念的“甜甜圈”，如今也精神失常在某个美国的高速公路，逢人便骂是国内派过去的间谍。】
可只有那些读懂讲师“黑话”的网友才明白，讲师不仅活得很滋润，并且可能已经快“永居”美国了。
跟其他的润人相比，讲师绝对算是其中比较特别的一个。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/38345.jpg
他早些年因效仿“窃格瓦拉·周”偷电瓶车进了局子，出来后被朋友骗着润到了美国。走投无路下，转而开始在美国贫民窟打着老佛爷付过钱的旗号，奉旨讨饭。
当各路美国本地人在斩杀线上被反复摩擦时，讲师这个外来的和尚却把要饭练成了一门学问。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/39766.jpg
禁止上手
虽然后续因各种原因，其国内社媒账号被全部封禁，但讲师的名声却已经在国内外打响了。彼时有很多的美国留学生、外籍华人联系过他，给了他很多的救济和帮助。
而不甘心热度散尽的讲师，又在YouTube开了账号，整了出“师徒三人”拉房车横穿西海岸的烂活。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/41618.jpg
没人知道那场徒步最后是怎么收场的，也许是师徒决裂，又或者是行李直接被本土特色零元购了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/41629.jpg
只是让人不得不佩服的是，讲师的运气似乎一直挺好。
当别的润人还在为黑户身份而苦恼的时候，旅游签进美的讲师却因一次被抢劫获得了U签。
也即因触发刑事类案件，为配合警方调查而给当事人颁发的非移民签证。该签证可在美国合法停留4年，可获得工作机会与社保号，理论上在美待够3年，便可获得绿卡。
尽管由于这类签证每年的配额有限，等排到讲师时已不知猴年马月。但根据国内另一位润美博主的爆料，为了能够往前加速审批，想抓住机会的讲师似乎开启了大举报时代。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_hhy_641_1/41698.jpg
从政策上讲，举报违法事实并不会加速政策审批，但为了加速审批而去举报，确实像讲师爱做的事
而讲师首先举报的，就是自己的舒适区——华人餐馆招黑工。
作为许多润人美国行的第一站，位于洛杉矶的“丁胖子广场”旁遍布华人餐馆。这些餐馆总是会以“照顾同胞”的名义，招揽走投无路的润人为其打黑工。
图源网络
很多满怀憧憬的润人都曾将这视为迈向“美国梦”的第一步，却殊不知这反倒成了资本主义剥削教给他们的第一课。
超高强度的工作时间，与微薄的薪水，让这些黑户润人们叫苦不迭。
有时还要面临着被拖薪、欠薪的问题
可不接受又能怎么办呢？没钱的阿美莉卡可不会有“当幸福来敲门”。
几年前，讲师也曾是其中的一份子。不同的是，不愿被餐馆老板当黑奴压榨的他，直接将餐馆雇黑工的事捅给了政府，此事后来还上了本地的华人报纸。
而讲师也无愧于“讲师”之名，当越来越多的润人向他取经时，他选择了面向市场开源，手把手教润人团体举报自己的黑老板。
在把华人餐馆整治得不敢招黑工后，讲师又把矛头瞄向了“洛杉矶市长”——唐市长。
你或许没听说过“唐市长”（小唐），但大概率听闻过他的事迹。作为北美新晋润人，小唐靠在洛杉矶贫民窟给流浪汉发“酱香饼”而闻名。
一开始他还算不得仁义，每张酱香饼敢卖60美元，算是把资本主义的风吹回了资本主义。
只不过后续因缺乏各种证件，他的摊子被频繁举报，在累计交了13万保释金后，才勉强保住了事业。
卖他是不能卖了，只能转而靠在国内直播带货赚钱，免费送的饼也只能算是养“死侍”了。
而他之所以会被讲师攻击，则是因为他直播带货的一款牙膏，被指是造假的“进口”。深受其害的讲师，如今正打算找律师告他假一赔三。
事实上，同为被派到洛杉矶的“斥候”，俩人之前在美国早见过几次面，还一起吃过饭。
关系说不上多好，但起码面上过得去。闹到如今的地步，倒不像是因为讲师正义心大起，更像是在经历流量滑坡后，苦于没活儿的他在疯狂找流量。
看过讲师的视频你会发现，在一众润人里他虽说不上嘴皮子最溜，心思最活络，但一定是最懂互联网的。
当牢A将斩杀线概念带火时，在斩杀线上反复横跳过的他，也没放过这波流量。作为前线最权威的记者，讲师也没少对“拼高达”“糖霜苹果”“系统删除”进行再注解。

news.title: Valor Mortis Review
news.summary: A novel soulslike packed with interesting ideas, even if they don’t always work out super smoothly.

others.title: Review: Valor Mortis (PS5) - Imperial Ambitions, Largely Realised

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/valormortis-review-blogroll-1791779447871.jpg

I’ve gotta hand it to the people at developer One More Level: after well over a decade of countless variations on the soulslike formula, I’ll admit that going first-person with BioShock-like magical abilities shooting out of your hand in an alternate history of the Napoleonic era is… a pretty darn original idea, actually. Valor Mortis is a punishing action game that tries a whole lot of compelling stuff, from combat that mixes sword fighting, spell slinging, and firearms, to the platforming sections that have you wall-running around like you’re in Titanfall, to the bizarre 19th-century setting that kept me guessing. These experiments work out for the most part, and I have many fond memories of dying again and again as I fought my way through this bleak world full of zombified French soldiers. But there are also plenty of moments when this hodgepodge of ideas doesn’t quite come together, not to mention numerous bugs and crashes that turned an otherwise good time into my own personal Waterloo. So while the 20-hour campaign can be a bit uneven, there are still enough interesting things going on in Valor Mortis to make it well worth playing.

If you’ve ever played a BioShock game, you’ll probably feel unexpectedly at home here. Valor Mortis shamelessly cribs the channeling-magic-powers-in-your-corrupted-left-hand concept, and also has the whole alternate history thing going for it as well. But instead of blasting your way through enemies with guns, you’ll mostly be getting up close and personal with a sword, parrying, dodging, and getting killed a whole bunch in the time-honored tradition of the soulslike. It’s an odd combination of things that works out better than I expected, as using your dominant hand for swashbuckling and your off-hand for guns and magical abilities makes for exciting encounters. For example, you might use your mutated arm to light an exploding barrel on fire from afar to take out a group of baddies, block an enemy that’s aggressively rushing you, then back away to finish them off with a pistol. Having so many options for how to deal with deadly enemies helped to hold my interest longer than Valor Mortis otherwise would have, especially given its overall lack of enemy variety.

You play as William, a soldier in Napoleon’s army in an alternate reality where the legendary emperor defeated his enemies at Waterloo, which… well, caused the world to look like a disturbing piece of abstract art, I guess. As an undead warrior with supernatural powers and the ability to come back from death as many times as you need, you fight your way through a series of depressing, war-ravaged areas, meeting a few mostly forgettable characters along the way. Valor Mortis might give off BioShock vibes, but when it comes to story, it falls quite short. It delivers a fairly generic “war is hell” message that’s undermined completely by the silly stuff happening around you, like that time you’re walking in a cave and suddenly find yourself in Egypt fighting off some kind of Spinx thing? I dunno, man. In any case, I’d still say this tries much harder than the average soulslike, but ends up being mostly disappointing.

Valor Mortis’ biggest shortcoming is that, possibly because it tries so many things at once, it can be quite a rocky ride, and that includes its combat. Some of it is minor, weird stuff, like how if you’re fighting big enemies, it feels like you’re hitting them with a pool noodle from several feet away due to some really strange invisible borders. But there are also more concerning issues, like the fact that sometimes enemies will just aim their aggression in a completely different direction, attacking the air or even just standing there while you kill them. And like lots of its peers, Valor Mortis also has that issue where each of the enemies only has a few attacks, so you’ll often just be waiting for them to repeat the same series of strikes for the third time in a row before you can finish them off with an execution. While fighting these gross monsters usually feels just fine, these shortcomings crop up with regularity.

However, a decently sized arsenal of weapons and powers helps to break up that monotony. You have three different melee options, three guns for toting, and three powers to turn your poor hand into a monstrous weapon of war – each with their own upgrade tree to customize how that ability works. For example, you can upgrade your flame ability so that enemies explode if you shoot them with a gun after lighting them on fire, or you can upgrade your saber so that it restores your stamina when you attack after successfully executing a dodge.

Beyond that, you’ve also got a whole skill tree full of perks to choose from and modifiers to equip that help you customize your build a little. Perks offer ways to help William survive a bit better by upping his health or making his parries more effective, but the mods (called Ambers) are more interesting, since they can actually alter the way your character works to suit your playstyle. In my case, I equipped a bunch of mods that made it easier to top off my health, like one that healed me whenever I performed an execution on an enemy whose posture I’d broken – I then equipped another called Perfectionism, which made me do substantially more damage when I was at full health. This allowed me to be a deadly perfectionist, who was rewarded with speedier skirmishes when I successfully managed to avoid taking hits.

Most soulslikes are defined by their memorable boss fights, and this is one area where Valor Mortis feels strangely out of the loop. First off, there are shockingly few of them, to the point where you can make several hours of forward progress without running into one. Secondly, when you eventually do, they are often underwhelming, especially the ones that are just beefier versions of existing enemies or repeated foes you’ve already fought. But even when they are original encounters, they all have the same issue: you’ll mostly just stand around waiting for the boss to pepper you with a ridiculously telegraphed attack so that you can parry it and counter once you’ve broken their posture. I died way more fighting random enemies and falling off of ledges than I did against these wimpy, disappointing bosses. Frankly, it’s probably a good thing there are so few since most aren’t very memorable, and battling through each of the levels against regular minions is much more consistently enjoyable.

One of the best parts about Valor Mortis’ weird-as-heck setting is that it makes for levels that are fairly unique, like the torn-up 19th-century battlefields filled with scattered horse corpses and discarded bayonets, or a harbor of destroyed naval ships that have been raised up into the air unnaturally. You still have plenty of soulslike cliches, like one part where you navigate a flooded village overcome by toxic waters (effectively your poison swamp level if it were created by war crimes), but I was pleasantly surprised by how many areas had personality or some kind of compelling component to pique my interest. For example, one level had me creeping around a ruined town where the only survivors were children who had learned to use their small size to their advantage. Working my way through the destruction while doing my best to gain the favor of these creepy kids was a neat and memorable section that has definitely stuck with me.

news.title: 《我不是药神》原型陆勇将停药 24年吃了3.5万片药
news.summary: 电影《我不是药神》的原型人物陆勇，即将停药

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122045474974.png
电影《我不是药神》的原型人物陆勇，即将停药。从2002年确诊慢性粒细胞白血病，到2026年10月，他已经吃下了超过3.5万片药，累计重量超过3.5公斤。24年的漫长服药史，在抑制病情的同时，也给他的身体带来了持续损伤。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122046077804.png
陆勇目前身体状况良好，已准备停药。他身边的几位病友也已经停药。根据他们的经验，陆勇描述停药后的变化：“皮肤不会像现在这么苍白，水肿几乎不会有了，肌肉也不像现在容易疲劳，也不会缺钙了。”这些在常人看来稀松平常的状态，对他而言却是等待了二十多年的“正常”。
陆勇的故事曾因2018年电影《我不是药神》而被公众熟知。他本人从患者变为推动进口抗癌药降价、纳入医保的民间力量，如今即将停药，也被视为慢粒白血病治疗领域漫长进步的一个缩影。

news.title: 《巫师3》重制变味？部分主机玩家强烈要求回退老版
news.summary: 《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》上线后，部分主机端玩家的不满情绪正在持续发酵。

content.v: 《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》上线后，部分主机端玩家的不满情绪正在持续发酵。大量PS5和Xbox Series X|S玩家希望回滚到更新前的次世代4.04版本，但主机平台不提供降级选项，而PC玩家在Steam上可以一键切换回旧版本。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122038228158.png

玩家对5.01补丁的抱怨主要集中在两方面。一是图形改动：与PS4原版和PS5的4.04版本相比，重制版在PS5 Pro上的提升被部分玩家认为“不明显”，甚至有些场景变得不自然。尤其是《血与酒》资料片中的陶森特地区，色彩被指过度饱和，失去了原本的质感。二是菜单、技能树和植被的变化。一位Reddit用户写道：“我想让我的Xbox Series X回到《巫师3》次世代4.04版本。除了错误和bug之外，游戏的整体氛围和外观完全变了，尤其是菜单、技能树和植被，我甚至找不到合适的词来形容。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122038344571.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122038353031.png
目前CDPR尚未就主机端回滚选项或图形反馈作出正式回应。PC玩家仍可通过Steam测试版功能自由切换版本，而主机玩家只能等待后续补丁或接受当前状态。

news.title: The RTX 4090 launched four years ago today, and now the RTX 5090 is rumoured for the chop, I can't help but look upon it with a warm glow
news.summary: Times, they have a-changed.

content.v: Join me in saying "Happy birthday" to the RTX 4090, Nvidia's enthusiast-level graphics card of the previous generation. It launched four years ago today, October 12, with an eye-watering MSRP of $1,499.

Well, eye-watering for the time. The cheapest RTX 5080 I can find right now is this Asus Prime variant for $1,640 , which is a sure sign of how things have changed in the past four years. When the second-from-top Nvidia card is now significantly more expensive than the launch MSRP of the previous generation big boi model, it's pretty easy to see how far we've fallen.

And the RTX 4090's direct replacement, the RTX 5090, has reached near-unobtanium status. We've stopped tracking it on our graphics card price watch page , as the only listings around are priced at ludicrous levels from third-party sellers we're not comfortable recommending. Now rumours suggest Nvidia may have halted production of RTX 5090 chips for the consumer market , with the GB202 silicon being used for data center and professional GPUs instead.

Which makes me think of the RTX 4090 with a heavy dose of nostalgia. I had a hunt through the PC Gamer kit cupboard recently and came across our review sample, an absolute cinderblock of a GPU that still looks outrageous today. And that's before you get to the specs sheet, which is still impressive in 2026.

24 GB of GDDR6X. 76.3 billion transistors. 16,384 CUDA cores, a 56% increase over the RTX 3090 . 128 shader modules, 128 ray tracing cores, 512 Tensor cores. This is still a giant of a graphics card even by modern standards, and I know quite a few gamers still running one. They bit the bullet and paid the then-exorbitant price tag, and have been enjoying the monstrous power of their over-specced GPU ever since.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uAvDHGUvLf9GJFfY7tbAuM-1920-80.jpg

If you had the cash on hand at the time, buying one was, in hindsight, a pretty smart move. Our Dave quite rightly called out the prohibitive pricing in his RTX 4090 Founders Edition review , but couldn't help but be impressed by its gaming chops—and it also provided us our first proper look at DLSS Frame Generation, in its early 2x form.

With so much grunt on offer, in combination with a new framerate-assisting feature, those who could swallow the price tag ended up with a GPU that still kicks like the proverbial mule all these years later.

And now an RTX 5080 costs more cash, with lesser raw performance (although with Multi Frame Generation support, which seems to have split the room in terms of gamer opinion), dropping such a sum on Nvidia's halo card seems to have worked out well for those who could afford it.

The RTX 5090 , however, has always been a more controversial GPU. Launching with a $1,999 MSRP (and soaring well above that in the retailer listings almost from the off), it's always been more difficult to square in terms of the price/performance metric—even if it does outperform the RTX 4090 by a considerable amount.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rhWu44sDqYPTAiiJjUGKsE-1920-80.jpg

And again, Multi Frame Generation is still a point of contention for some. The RTX 5090 remains the poster boy for the tech, despite being announced alongside the RTX 5080, RTX 5070 Ti , and RTX 5070 at CES 2025. I remember covering the announcement alongside my colleagues in Las Vegas, and wondering how the PC gaming community would react.

Yes, it boosts the number of frames displayed considerably. But it was always going to further the "fake frames" debate that was already rumbling underneath the older, 2x frame gen implementation. And while the RTX 5090 is still a massively powerful GPU in its own right, the pricing was sure to push many gamers out in the cold. Particularly if they had an RTX 4090 in their rig already. Why upgrade, when your current card was still an absolute monster?

Perhaps that's the legacy of the RTX 4090. The more I think about it, the more I think it might be the last halo GPU that made sense for a regular consumer to buy. It danced with a concept we tend to avoid mentioning in this industry—futureproofing, a dirty word I use with extreme caution here.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HeZDqTpXAGEqNAmxywrCJ9-1920-80.jpg

Certainly, graphics card pricing looks to be turbo-screwed for the foreseeable future. And while the RTX 60-series is likely to be a way out yet, I can only imagine that whatever RTX 6090-equivalent is coming our way will be both ludicrously priced, and stuffed full of Tensor cores for more Multi Frame Generation shenanigans, now with DLSS 5 thrown on top.
Neural rendering is the future , as far as Nvidia is concerned. More hardware doohickies to supplement it, with less focus on raw performance uplift? That's where my money would be going.

Something about the four year anniversary of Nvidia's now-legendary 40-series card makes me pine for the days when GPUs were more straightforward affairs, raw graphics-crunching monsters available for sums that were at least somewhat within reach for those of us with more modest salaries.

Which is a wild thing to say about a $1,499, four-year-old GPU, I know. But the state of graphics card pricing in 2026 has thrown all previous metrics for a loop, and there's not a whole lot we can do about it. Anyway, raise a glass to the RTX 4090 with me. Somehow, I have a feeling we won't see its like again.

news.title: 一加16正式发布！8E6芯片 全球首发185Hz 5999起
news.summary: 一加16发布，搭载第六代骁龙8至尊版、全球首发185Hz高刷，5999元起。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122019147552.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122026234623.jpg
一加16手机于10月12日正式发布，新品首批搭载第六代骁龙8超级至尊版芯片，采用2nm制程，官方称其为安卓阵营迄今最快的2nm移动芯片。该机全球首发185Hz极速高刷，定价5999元起，国补后5199元起，将于10月13日10:00正式开售。外观提供明日星光、黑暗森林、火星杰作三款配色，采用1.15mm极窄四等边设计。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122021032521.jpg
屏幕方面，一加16全球首发第四代东方屏，定制X4发光材料，支持真硬件1nits与全场景“太阳显示”，率先支持全局165Hz、游戏185Hz。相较120帧，185帧流畅度提升超50%，每秒多显示65帧画面，官方称可帮助玩家在游戏中更早发现敌人、更快出手。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122023065394.jpg
性能层面，新机出厂写入全新一代“风驰游戏内核”，基于全新GPU带来行业首个多帧生成渲染能力。同时配备电竞三芯——电竞网络芯片G3、超级显示芯片P4、灵犀触控芯片T3，分别强化信号、清晰度和触控响应，并搭载“冰河散热系统”与高精度大师陀螺仪。续航上，该机内置9000mAh冰川电池，支持100W超级闪充与50W无线闪充。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122023356341.jpg
游戏适配方面，一加16可实现《和平精英》《三角洲行动》原生185FPS持久满帧，并首批支持《暗区突围》《无畏契约：能源行动》《火影忍者》《穿越火线：枪战王者》《萤火突击》原生185Hz高刷模式，以及《王者荣耀》原生165帧。以上为厂商公布的参数与表述，最终实际表现以用户体验为准。

news.title: 霸王茶姬给员工发1350万元奖励 买一送一活动太辛苦
news.summary: 霸王茶姬将发放总计1350万元的专项奖励

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122012106741.png
10月12日，霸王茶姬为庆祝全球品牌代言人郑钦文夺得中网女单冠军，推出全品类“买一送一”活动，全国订单量远超预期，官方小程序一度因流量过大出现访问故障。针对活动期间门店伙伴的高强度付出，公司已向全国门店发布内部感谢信，对一线员工的坚守与服务表示肯定。

内部信同时宣布，将发放总计1350万元的专项奖励：其中350万元作为“伙伴团建费”，1000万元作为“伙伴激励专项红包”。所有奖励将尽快落实到每一位参与本次活动保障的门店员工手中。霸王茶姬方面表示，此次活动的高强度运转离不开一线员工的支撑，公司希望通过专项奖励表达对员工的感谢与认可。

news.title: 《恶魔城》新作专为初代Switch打造！二代靠兼容运行
news.summary: 科乐美新作《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》专为初代Switch打造，Switch2仅能兼容运行，引发讨论。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122001129948.png
科乐美旗下《恶魔城》系列新作《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》将于10月15日登陆Nintendo Switch、PS5、Xbox Series X|S与Steam等平台。不过在发售前，这款游戏的处理方式引发了讨论——它并非为任天堂新主机Switch2专门打造，而是专为初代Switch开发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122001437490.jpg
这意味着，Switch2玩家只能通过向下兼容来运行本作，游戏本身并没有针对新主机进行优化。 向下兼容虽能小幅提升帧率，却不会带来专属的材质、纹理或硬件层面的重制，无法完全发挥新主机的潜力。 在初代Switch上，游戏锁定30帧；而在Switch2上运行时可达60帧，但画面与性能仍基于旧主机的底层代码，并未获得专属的画质、分辨率或帧率层面的强化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610122002379077.jpg

news.title: The New Squadron 42 Trailer Looks Great, But That 2027 Release Date Is Hard To Believe
news.summary: Star Citizen 's single-player mode, Squadron 42, has made a reappearance with a new trailer showing off the mo

content.v: Star Citizen 's single-player mode, Squadron 42, has made a reappearance with a new trailer showing off the mode's impressive cast and interstellar warfare. In development for 12 years, the ambitious mode blends outer space dogfighting and first-person action, set during an era when hostile alien forces have pushed humanity to the brink of defeat. As a rising star in the United Empire of Earth Navy, players must push back the invaders and save the day.

The new trailer is the best look yet at the mode and the many, many actors who play various characters in the story mode. From Mark Hamill (who knows a thing or two about space combat) to Gary Oldman, the rest of the cast also includes Gillian Anderson, Ben Mendelsohn, Henry Cavill, Andy Serkis, John Rhys-Davies, Rhona Mitra, and more famous faces in the mix. For the player characters, Ian Duncan (Broken News) plays the male player character, while Alix Wilton Regan (the new face and voice of Tomb Raider games ) portrays the female player character.

With development being led by Wing Commander creator Chris Roberts at Cloud Imperium Games, the trailer includes a healthy mix of cinematics and gameplay, showing off on-foot sections, life aboard the capital ship that players will be stationed on, minigames, and the space combat that fans of the genre have shown up for. There's no solid release date yet for the mode, but a Q2 2027 release window is listed instead, and you can wishlist it now on the CIG website and Steam. As of 2023, CIG described the standalone campaign as feature-complete , and the team said it was working on "dialing in" the gameplay so it would feel as "immersive as possible."

Squadron 42 has been brewing in the background ever since Star Citizen was first announced, with the mode seemingly being close to release earlier this year and then getting a delay to 2027 so that it could escape being overshadowed by GTA 6--which to be fair, is a strategy that many games have opted for recently.

"Much like the rest of the industry there is no way I want to launch my spiritual successor to Wing Commander, a game that has had 12 years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it, launching into the attention buzz saw of GTA 6," Roberts wrote in a blog post earlier this year. "While GTA 6 isn’t launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage."

Development on Star Citizen is still ongoing, and the game has raised over $1 billion in funding since it was first announced. A large chunk of that cash comes from CIG selling spaceships that can cost as much as $5,000 each , money that the game's devoted fanbase is happy to spend on the project. Worryingly, Star Citizen was in the spotlight after a r ecent developer livestream intended to show the game off in a positive light.
But instead of seeing what Star Citizen could be, the gameplay shown off was littered with bugs, glitches, and palpable tension between the developers as they attempted to salvage the broadcast.

news.title: 'Your washing machine is subject to more safety rules than AI' says Microsoft president
news.summary: When the call for external regulation is coming from inside AI's house, you know it's serious.

content.v: Microsoft president Brad Smith claims that AI is currently less regulated than the food we eat and the utilities we rely on. "Right now, your washing machine is subject to more safety rules than AI," Smith said, "Every carton of milk that you see in the grocery store is subject to safety rules and inspection."

Smith isn't just talking about the US either, calling for safety rules to be put in place globally. Smith called for various safety measures while speaking on the BBC's Big Boss podcast , including a legal obligation to notify victims if their systems have been compromised by rogue AI agents. This would definitely be timely, given how OpenAI's agents hacked into Hugging Face and were the source of various other ' incidents ' earlier this year.

Smith also advocated for "outside evaluators" to test AI products before release, and a "safety brake" for autonomous systems, describing AI as both a "tool and a weapon." These comments run counter to the sentiment of the US administration; President Trump's current strategy demonstrates little desire to pump the brakes, instead hoping to chart ' a decisive course to cement US dominance in artificial intelligence .'

Last month, the US president issued an executive order that renames 'Artificial Intelligence' to 'Super Intelligence .' Shortly before that, Trump Media partnered with AI search engine Perplexity to create Truth Search AI, in a bid to " end Big Tech's assault on free speech ." All of that is to say, Trump appears to still be all-in on AI .

Unsurprisingly, the Microsoft boss is looking to places beyond the US to lead the regulatory charge, saying, "Most people that I know would say, if you ask them, 'name the country that is the leader in having this technical capability,' they would say, 'it's very simple. It's the United Kingdom. They are the best.'"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xMoG7mKtMPqphYvP3YEEoL-1920-80.jpg

The UK government established what is now known as the AI Security Institute back in 2023, apparently the first state-backed AI safety body of its kind. It's a weird thing to feel anything like national pride over, but this Brit will take it—alongside the reminder that we've seen about three different Prime Ministers enter 10 Downing Street since the institute was established such a relatively short time ago.

Anyway, as for the wider AI industry, it's not just Brad Smith advising caution. Back in September, an ex-Anthropic and OpenAI researcher made the attention grabbing claim that AI developments "could kill us all by the end of the decade ." Around the same time, Anthropic boss Dario Amodei made more measured calls for AI development to slow down .

Similarly to Smith's suggestions, Amodei also outlined the need for "embedded evaluators who have employee-like access to verify safety practices and report incidents." Since then, executives from Nvidia, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and SpaceX all agreed to work with independent auditors as part of signing White House Accord on Super Intelligence . Brad Smith says Microsoft would be "happy to sign it," describing the Accord as "a good step."

However, Smith was also cautious about the document's emphasis on self-regulation. He said, "The good companies will do what you want. It's the companies that are not as responsible that you need to worry about."

news.title: Here come the weird and wonderful mods for the Steam Frame, as Valve drops the full CAD files for free
news.summary: I bet someone is already mocking up cat ears for this thing.

content.v: Valve has released the CAD files for the Steam Frame , allowing modders the perfect opportunity to get to work on their own creations for the VR headset.

The light blocker—the bit that sits between the bridge of your nose and the headset—is primed for user replacement, as are the head strap, battery housing, facial interface and more. This CAD release includes the lot, along with the core module and controllers.

Valve has confirmed it is working on an upgraded head strap with interchangeable batteries and off-ear speakers for the Steam Frame. That's " coming soon ". With this CAD release, perhaps we'll see more options for third parties in future, too.

The docs also detail how to interface with the expansion port , or auxiliary port as Valve calls it. This sits just to the front of the user's nose and is a way for a user to add in powered accessories, ie the Arcturus Vision RGB camera—I've been playing around with that for a couple of weeks and it's a pretty wicked upgrade. With one Gen4 PCIe lane alongside power and camera functionality, all laid out in the docs, there's a bunch more that could be done with the port. I'm just hoping someone runs with it.

With this release, Valve has a full sweep of CAD files available for all of its most recent products. There's the Steam Deck , Steam Machine , Steam Controller , and now Steam Frame. That's how it should be done, people.

news.title: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Boosters Are Back in Stock, but Where’s the Best Price Right Now?

Amazon has recently restocked its allocation of Pokémon TCG's 30th Celebration Booster Bundles , which are currently available for $99. But is it the best deal going right now?
Unfortunately, no, this is still above and beyond MSRP, and considerably more than Amazon was selling the booster bundles for in September ($45).

There's been a dramatic fall in market value on the 30th Anniversary boosters, dropping 35.43% in just the last month. We were seeing these go for around $120 at the end of September, but you can now pick one up, new and sealed, for about $74 on resale.

It's not great versus the $45 Amazon price we saw last month, but still a lot better than the $99 at Amazon now. I'd expect Amazon to drop their price further in the coming days, in order to shift the new stock allocation, especially since the major retailer does like to try and stick close to market rates when it can.

For $99, you're looking at $16.50 per pack (6 in total). At $74, that brings it down to $12.33 per pack. Still not wonderful, but as I said, not as bad as it could be. If anything, it might be worth holding out in case these drop even further, as I don't expect us trainers will be all too thrilled to be paying $70+ for six boosters.

news.title: Haunted Chocolatier Is For “The People In Stardew Valley That Go Into The Mines”
news.summary: Haunted Chocolatier, the second game from Stardew Valley creator, Eric Barone, has been in development for mor

content.v: Haunted Chocolatier, the second game from Stardew Valley creator, Eric Barone, has been in development for more than five years, having been announced in October 2021. While there's no official word on the Haunted Chocolatier release date , Barone has been discussing the development of the game, including who it's for and more about the playstyle. In a recent interview with GQ , Barone said that Haunted Chocolatier is "more of an action RPG," although it is still what he'd call "a town game."

"The main focus is more about adventuring, finding equipment and getting more powerful. There are monsters, there are boss fights. It's for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines," he explained.

Writing on the Haunted Chocolatier website , Barone regularly apologizes for the game "taking so long," but reassures fans that he's making good progress on the game. "I won't compromise on the quality of the game by rushing it or releasing it too early," he adds.

Still, now that we have more information on what the game might entail, the wait feels like it will be worth it. According to GQ, Barone has "returned to isolation" to focus on finishing Haunted Chocolatier. "I really want to recapture that feeling that I had when I was making Stardew Valley," Barone said. "Everyone's watching me, and if I don't do things a certain way, it might disappoint millions of people."

Haunted Chocolatier is also shaping up to be bigger, and creepier, than Stardew Valley. In 2025, Barone said he "hoped" the game would release within the next five years, so we should get our hands on it before 2030, all being well. Fingers crossed.

news.title: 10天偷跑超1TB流量！咖啡机竟是家里WiFi变慢元凶
news.summary: 网友家智能咖啡机10天产生超1TB上行流量，导致WiFi拥堵，重启移至独立网络后恢复。

content.v: 家里WiFi变慢，原因有时出人意料。近日，一名自称有超过10年IT从业经验的网友在帮父母排查家中网速变慢的问题时，发现“元凶”竟是一台智能咖啡机。这类藏在智能家居里的“蹭网大户”，往往比想象中更不易察觉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121901186645.png
他公布的网络管理截图显示，这台咖啡机在连接约10天9小时的时间里，累计产生了1008.45GB上行流量和9.94GB下行流量，平均每天约97GB，估算平均上行速率约9Mbps。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121844283067.png

出现问题的产品具体型号为Keurig K-Supreme SMART with BrewID。除基本冲煮功能外，它还支持通过App远程启停、预约冲煮，以及亚马逊Alexa、谷歌Google Home等语音助手控制，BrewID功能可经WiFi识别咖啡胶囊并据此调整参数。按常理，检查冲煮状态、识别胶囊、下载固件都不会产生如此大的流量，而Keurig并未公开咖啡机固件，外界尚不清楚异常究竟发生在哪个环节。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121847013065.png
这位网友推测，大部分流量或仅在家庭局域网内传输、并未发往外部互联网。他曾打算用Wireshark抓包确认传输内容，但最终放弃，因此具体成因未能证实。他将咖啡机重启并移至独立VLAN（虚拟局域网）后，问题暂时得到解决，并呼吁Keurig检查设备的网络协议栈，避免类似异常再次发生。此事也提醒智能家居用户重新审视自家设备的网络占用——为IoT设备单独划网，或许能避开这类不易察觉的“网络挤兑”。

news.title: 沙耶之歌同人图超美！小岛工作室巨乳中国画师发新作

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121836213187.jpg
《沙耶之歌》发售至今已有二十多年，但这部老作品时不时仍能迎来高质量的二创。近日，小岛工作室首席概念设计师Entei Ryu在社交平台分享了自己绘制的《沙耶之歌》同人插画，作品很快引来不少网友围观。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121837044941.jpg
Entei Ryu是一位旅居东京的中国概念艺术家，毕业于东京大学建筑系，现任小岛工作室首席概念设计师，曾参与《最终幻想16》《刺客信条》系列等项目，并为《死亡搁浅2》收藏版设计了“麦哲伦巨人”雕像，小岛秀夫曾称她为“来自5次元的艺术家”。她的作品风格融合古典写实与东方意境，此前还创作过《新世纪福音战士》《剑风传奇》等作品的同人或授权雕塑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121837573149.jpg
这次她笔下的沙耶保留了标志性的绿色长发与红绿撞色，血肉与枝叶缠绕的意象贴合原作猎奇又唯美的基调。三张插画分别以回眸、正面与全身构图呈现，暗红底色配上飞溅的血肉细节，把原作那种美好表象下透着诡异的感觉还原得相当到位。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121838251185.jpg
《沙耶之歌》由Nitro+出品、虚渊玄编剧，2003年发售，以猎奇与纯爱交织的剧情闻名。

news.title: Why Paying "Market Price" for Rare Pokémon Card Sets Somehow Became The New Normal
news.summary: Pokémon TCG market prices often exceed MSRP, but they can help collectors avoid scalpers' worst prices, so her

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/17/most-expensive-pokemon-cards-of-2026-2-1786972372948.png

Even for the biggest and most popular games, getting products at MSRP (Manufacturer’s Suggested Retail Price) should indeed be the norm; nevertheless, for those like the Pokémon TCG , ‘market price’ has become the go-to metric for many collectors for one big reason.
Depending on your perspective as a Pokemon fan, referring to the concept as a gateway to ‘inflated’ or ‘rip-off’ pricing is totally valid.

That said, when actually getting down to the logistics of what it means to get a box of new Pokémon cards at MSRP today, the “market price”, well, market — has been the response to a growing problem with the collectables market as a whole, and is still a legitimate way to enjoy the Pokémon TCG (very much within reason).
Buying at MSRP Is Almost Impossible Right Now
To first put it plainly before going into the nitty-gritty, the rise of paying “market price” for Pokemon cards over MSRP ultimately comes down to one classic concept: supply vs. demand.

Over the past couple of years, especially, the demand for the latest boxes of Pokemon cards from new expansions and special collections has gotten so high that supply has consequently not been able to keep up with the demand.

What started all this, of course, was the mainstream discovery of valuable ‘chase cards’ — those regarded with astronomical value due to their rarity, like the famous $1,300+ Umbreon ex from Prismatic Evolutions .

From then on, in a sort of snowball effect, the market became diluted by many buyers buying as much stock as possible, in hopes of pulling the rarest and most expensive cards for profit — nefarious scalpers either flooding retail stores like Costco to physically hoard any stock, or utilising bots to sweep up any stock drops online.

Even if you're regularly online as a full-time remote worker or something similar, any sites selling Pokemon stock either get met with huge crashes, or instanly long queues with everyting sold out at MSRP by the time you can actually get in and shop.

With all of that, you would normally be faced with either needing to practically camp out in front of retail stores before opening hours, or regularly check online stores — such as Best Buy and Target — in hopes of getting lucky to be visiting a site when a stock drop happens. In contrast, the other option is simply giving in to the scalpers and forking over whatever extortionate prices they’re willing to charge.
For Many, "Market Price" is the Tolerable Alternative
Responding to the dire need for some form of regulation in the trading card market, market price estimations are essentially the slightly happier medium option.

Calculated by dedicated online marketplaces like TCGplayer, market price is a way of attempting fair estimation for a product when MSRP isn’t an option — weighing up factors about a card or product like its general rarity, artwork, contents, and any impact it might make on its card game’s meta.

Applicable to essentially any other card game like Magic: The Gathering , Yu-Gi-Oh , or the One Piece Card Game , market price has become the new metric for letting Pokemon collectors know whether a higher-than-MSRP price is fair in respect to its demand vs supply, if you’re simply getting ripped off, or if a price is suspiciously so low by comparison, it might be a scammer listing.

For example, there are some eBay sellers charging over $350 for one of the Pokemon TCG’s Ascended Heroes Elite Trainer Boxes; whereas, on TCGplayer, the market price is estimated at a much lower $153.54 — with, at the time of writing, listings there selling for $148 at the lowest .
It’s Still Okay to Be Annoyed About MSRP

While it’s definitely better paying a tamer market price than whatever an unchecked scalper thinks is worthy, it’s also completely fair to remain upset over the current state of the Pokemon TCG, where buying at market price still isn’t feasible.

After all, if the company that makes the actual product declares that said product should only be worth so many dollars or British pounds, it’s right to believe that you should be only paying that price, and not a penny more.
The next go-to thought for anyone just getting into the TCG is that the Pokemon Company should just print enough cards so there’s enough for everyone and eliminate the scalper market altogether.

However, that is actually what the Pokemon Company has been doing. Just last year alone, over 10 billion Pokemon cards were printed ; in context, that’s out of the 85 billion since the card game’s conception — meaning 11% of a 30-year-old card game’s output was carried out in just 12 months.

What’s more, when it comes to the 30th Celebration expansion, vastly improved pull rates for the more in-demand cards have deeply hit scalper operations and have had resellers moan that it isn’t ‘profitable enough’ , since more people getting to pull their chase cards have lowered their market prices as a result.

Despite those major wins for the actual fandoms aside, though, they aren’t enough — at least, not yet. If something is popular enough, tickets, products, goods, etc, will continue to sell despite the controversy around it. In this case, the overall demand for Pokemon TCG cards is still so astronomically high that it still isn’t currently enough to eliminate the need to shop by market price and bring back MSRP as the default.

Those hoarding product just to resell have lost out on some profit incentive, sure, but currently not enough to stop them wanting to spend the time raiding physical and digital shelves entirely. Like the aforementioned snowball effect that kickstarted Pokemon’s lucrative reseller market in the first place, it needs to steadily wind back down in the same way — as more scalpers slowly back out and leave product for the pure fans.

Unfortunately, that will take a long while, and plenty of Pokemon lovers don’t want to take an uncertain amount of time out of the hobby they enjoy. That’s why the ‘market price’ way of buying Pokemon cards is still the go-to metric even now: for those just wanting the best possible price for product that’s readily available — if they don’t want to spend time fighting off scalpers for MSRP — and can make an informed decision as to whether that’s right for them.

For those who can only currently afford to buy Pokemon cards at MSRP, retailer initiatives like Amazon’s invite-only listings are a great way to still score product at their intended price. On the other hand, those required restocks are still being spread across an increasingly keen customer base — making actual invites hard to come by.

Shopping by market price still may not be the perfect resolution for those who only wish to shop by MSRP, but for buyers who wish to buy Pokemon cards at a reasonable rate via the safest method available — it’s in most cases, the best we have until things get better.

news.title: Why Games Workshop's Falling Share Price Is All of a Sudden in the News
news.summary: Warhammer 40,000 maker Games Workshop has found itself in the news for its falling share price, which has left

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/gw-1791800697378.jpg
Warhammer 40,000 maker Games Workshop has found itself in the news for its falling share price, which has left some wondering what’s going on behind the scenes.

Games Workshop is one of the UK's biggest success stories, with its stock rising more than 70% over the past five years. But its share price has fallen 13.76% over the past six months, wiping hundreds of millions of pounds off the value of the company. This comes even as Games Workshop reports record profits. So, what’s going on?

Broadly speaking, there seems to be investor nervousness at Games Workshop’s ability to keep growing in the face of rising manufacturing and logistics costs. Some on the internet will say the recently released 11th edition of flagship tabletop wargame Warhammer 40,000 hasn’t done as well as Games Workshop had hoped, but there is no official data to back this claim up. Indeed, in an update issued mid-September, Games Workshop said that trading to August 30 was “in line with the Board’s expectations for the current financial year.”

However, there is certainly a feeling that Games Workshop may have hit a wall in terms of the popularity of its tabletop games, particularly Warhammer 40,000, which has seen multiple new, pricey miniatures released recently amid claims of over-saturation.

Things ramped up last week with two reports from the financial press about the state of Games Workshop. The first, from the Financial Times , titled ‘Is Warhammer still winning?’ The FT pointed out that while GW’s financials are, broadly speaking, very positive, retail growth per store turned negative for the first time since the pandemic in the second half of its 2026 financial year.

Then there was a report in The Times titled, ‘Games Workshop takes a hammering after mystery report.’ This story claimed a confidential Dragoneye document had wiped £480 million (approx. $635 million) off the company’s value “as the closely guarded contents trigger unease among investors.”

What’s in this Dragoneye document? We don’t know, but The Times said it was about the potential for slowing growth at Games Workshop. It’s interestingly timed, and Dragoneye is a short-focused research firm, so its report should be read with that in mind. Through it all is the obvious point that projecting a slowdown in consumer spending on Games Workshop products shouldn't come as a surprise to anyone. The global economy is struggling, the rising cost of living has caused many to rethink their spending, and AI has everyone spooked about jobs.

So, while some fans are taking to subreddits to express concern about the future of Games Workshop, there is nothing here to indicate the company is in any sort of trouble. Quite the opposite. And let’s not remember what’s in the works for Warhammer. Big hitting video games such as Total War: Warhammer 40,000 and Space Marine 3 are due out in the coming years, and Henry Cavill is soldiering on with his Warhammer 40,000 Cinematic Universe for Amazon. The entertainment push to broaden the appeal of the Warhammer 40,000 IP is surely going to stand Games Workshop in good stead over the years.
And, at the time of this article’s publication, Games Workshop’s share price was up 1.22%. The Emperor, it seems, protects.
Photo by Matthew Lloyd/Getty Images.

content.v: 近日，由谭松韵、刘学义领衔主演的古装剧《兰香如故》迎来大结局，剧中谭松韵挑战超高难度年龄跨度，从17岁少女一路演到80岁老妇。
剧组随后公开幕后花絮，显示谭松韵为呈现真实老年状态，不惜耗时6小时进行全脸及双手特效化妆，引发网友热烈讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_15/1123.jpg
画面中满布皱纹的双手与沧桑面容细节逼真，不少粉丝和观众大赞其敬业精神；然而，网络讨论区也出现另一种极端声音，部分观众质疑造型过度追求古装剧的“头包脸”美学，反而与老年妆容产生严重违和感，令评价呈两极化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_15/1229.jpg
在《兰香如故》的后期剧情中，谭松韵饰演的角色历经人生沧桑步入暮年。为追求极致的视觉震撼，剧组特效化妆团队打造了极其繁复的特效妆容。据媒体报道，拍摄前团队先对演员进行3D面部扫描并生成老年效果图，再以薄软硅胶假皮贴合脸部，全脸刻画超过60条深重皱纹，并仔细绘制眼袋、老年斑及耳后细纹。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_15/1375.jpg
官方公开的幕后影片显示，谭松韵需连续6小时保持静止进行脸部与双手倒模与贴皮特效化妆。除了面部老化外，团队对双手的皮肤松弛度、关节纹路与斑驳细节也讲究至极。幕后影片释出后，不少观众被谭松韵的敬业态度与精细特效化妆打动，大赞其成功打破“娃娃脸”框架，展现出极强的角色感染力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_15/1515.jpg
影片曝光后，随即引发网络激辩。支持者纷纷为谭松韵的专业态度点赞，直言“连手的皱纹都做得很服帖，看到眼眶泛泪”“从年轻演到老的角色感染力极强，年轻演员能做到这样真的很难得”。

news.title: IGN满分《火纹》日本玩家不买账?两极分化的"怪作"
news.summary: 近日，日本游戏媒体GameSpark发布了《火焰纹章 万紫千红》的评测，分析了游戏在发售后评价两极分化的原因。

content.v: 近日，日本游戏媒体GameSpark发布了《火焰纹章 万紫千红》的评测，分析了游戏在发售后评价两极分化的原因。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121754131313.png
该媒体认为，本作拥有独特的玩法设计与出色的群像剧，但冗长的前期流程、不足的角色互动以及后期剧情乏力等问题，也掩盖了游戏本身的魅力。
在海外评分网站Metacritic上，本作M站媒体评分为89分，用户评分为8.6分，而日本亚马逊评分却仅为3.6星，玩家评价存在明显分歧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121757397073.png
首先，游戏玩法的变化让玩家产生了不同感受。 本作融合了《火焰纹章 风花雪月》的日历系统与《火焰纹章 外传》的世界地图机制，玩家除了参与战棋战斗，还需要探索大陆、收集资源、培养角色并管理声望。GameSpark认为，这种宏观策略与微观战棋相结合的设计颇具特色，但准备阶段耗时较长，对于只想体验战斗的玩家而言可能比较煎熬。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121757492663.png
其次，四位主角的故事风格差异过大。 凯、迪特里希、塞奥多拉和蕾达分别拥有不同的剧情主题，涵盖神话、科幻、国家战争与个人复仇等内容。媒体认为，这种差异化让多周目体验更加丰富，但玩家如果不喜欢初次选择的路线，可能很难坚持下去。此外，游戏后期与魔神巴罗尔的决战趋于简单的善恶对立，前期塑造的世界观和角色也未能得到充分发挥。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121757599782.png
第三，角色互动内容有所缩水。 前作《风花雪月》凭借大量支援对话塑造了鲜明的角色形象，而本作的支援对话数量明显减少。由于玩家能够自由招募不同角色，部分同伴甚至直到通关都没有机会触发支援对话，导致一些角色最终沦为单纯的战斗单位。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121758095980.png
最后，游戏引导与系统设计不够协调。 尽管本作提供了教程和任务指引，但部分重要机制缺少说明，一些剧情事件的提示也不够醒目。新增的指令式快速战斗还拖慢了探索节奏，而游戏真正有趣的策略系统往往要到后期才逐渐展现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121758173575.png
GameSpark总结称，《火焰纹章 万紫千红》是一部优缺点都十分鲜明的挑战之作。宏观策略玩法与差异化群像剧构成了游戏的独特魅力，但前期节奏、角色塑造和系统引导上的不足，也让部分玩家难以充分体验这些亮点。

news.title: 爱用洗衣凝珠的人天塌了登热搜 医生回应伤害有多大
news.summary: 导致高浓度洗涤剂溅入眼球腐蚀角膜，部分案例视力一度降至0.06甚至角膜局部缺失

content.v: 近日，#爱用洗衣凝珠的人天塌了#登上热搜引热议，有网友发布视频表示，自己的妻子在洗涤衣物时，试图分开两颗受潮粘连的洗衣凝珠，但凝珠在撕开瞬间突然爆破炸裂，高浓度洗涤液直接溅入眼。起初以为简单冲洗即可，未料疼痛加剧，跑了三家医院才确诊角膜已被腐蚀掉一小块……
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_14/199.jpg

那么，洗衣凝珠为什么会对眼睛有这么大的伤害？如果不幸被洗衣凝珠里面的液体溅到应该怎么办呢？记者就此采访了浙江省中山医院眼科王洁主任。医生表示，普通洗衣液有效成分浓度约为10%-20%，而洗衣凝珠的高浓缩表面活性剂、碱性助剂占比可达80%以上，直接接触眼球时腐蚀性远高于普通洗衣液。同时，凝珠中的碱性成分接触角膜后，不会像酸性物质那样快速凝固表层组织，反而会持续向组织深层渗透，短时间内即可腐蚀角膜上皮。由于眼球黏膜本身极其脆弱，角膜表面没有角质层作为保护屏障，高浓度洗涤液附着后，几分钟内就会引发明显的化学灼伤，直接出现剧痛、畏光、视力下降等症状。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_14/1230.jpg

如果不幸被洗衣凝珠里面的液体溅到眼睛，医生表示，第一处置步骤为立刻前往水龙头处，撑开上下眼睑，使用流动清水或生理盐水从内眼角向外眼角缓慢冲洗眼球，冲洗过程中频繁眨眼、轻轻转动眼球，总冲洗时长不得少于15分钟，进液量较大时可延长冲洗时间至30分钟。如果事发时佩戴隐形眼镜，需在冲洗过程中直接摘除，避免化学物质附着在镜片上持续刺激角膜。冲洗完成后，即便眼部疼痛有所缓解，也不可自行随意滴用各类眼药水，需第一时间前往眼科就诊。
医生也提醒，绝对不要用手揉搓眼睛，凝珠残留的化学成分会跟着摩擦进一步加深角膜损伤，也不要用纸巾、干毛巾直接擦拭眼球表面，很容易造成额外的角膜擦伤。此外，医生也表示，不能仅凭“冲洗后疼痛消失”就判断完全无碍，部分碱性灼伤的损伤存在延迟显现特征，拖延数小时就可能错过最佳处理窗口。
医生表示，后续就医时，最好带上涉事洗衣凝珠的外包装，方便医生直接查看产品成分表，开展针对性的中和处置。如果冲洗后，仍持续出现视力模糊、畏光、剧烈疼痛、红肿加重等情况，需及时返回医院复诊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_14/1354.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121745339693.jpg

news.title: iPhone Duo首发 黄牛加价1.2万！抢到就是赚到？

content.v: 26年 真正的“赛博茅台”来了！
iPhone Duo将在10月16日晚8点接受预购，10月23日发售。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874468.jpg
前期各种Duo良率爆炸，甚至苹果一度要延迟发布的消息轮番上热搜。
且供应链消息称首批备货量比较少，属于是“僧多机少”。
所以这波首发能有多缺货，黄牛就能有多开心。
甚至一度传出了需要加价 1.2 万，才承诺让你在首发当天拿到货。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874467.jpg
图片来源：微博 @梨视频
要知道苹果官网目前标出的起售价是15999元。 如果按入门款再加上这笔钱来算，总支出就是27999元，涨幅约75%。
为了一台首发拿到Duo，要掏接近两台的预算，鸭只能说不如 顾 120个人帮你抢首发更实在一点。
不过，大部分商家还是表示要看首发当天的行情，鸭也是在某二手平台上瞅了一眼。
帮你代拍的，价格在300-800之间浮动，比较吃你所在的城市有没有苹果直营店。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874464.jpg
如果想要保证你当天可以收到货，加价就在大几千之间不等。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874463.jpg
看目前的趋势，除了职业黄牛估计也会有不少“路人牛”想着从中捞一笔。
PS.鸭还是建议普通人，没有购买欲望就还是别当路人牛了，万一机器砸手里可不是一个小数目。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874469.gif
当然，Duo本身也确实有让人想尝鲜的地方。
这是苹果第一款折叠屏iPhone，大伙都想看看最晚交折叠屏作业的苹果能整出啥新花样，尤其是在适配上到底咋样？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874465.jpg
而安卓用户，到底愿不愿意为这块能折起来的苹果屏幕换阵营？
Android Authority在10月9日公布了一次读者投票结果，共1211票。
16.1%的参与者表示愿意从安卓转向iPhone Duo，另有10.6%给出了条件：相机更强，才考虑。
剩下的34.4%选择继续留在安卓阵营，38.9%则对折叠屏不感兴趣。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874466.jpg
苹果的折叠屏还在收集“想买”，而已经开卖的18 Pro系列，倒是结结实实的卖疯了。
据爆料iPhone 18 Pro系列在国内开售三周累计激活289万台，到10月9日，实时累计激活量已超过300万台。
其中，9月28日至10月4日这一周，Pro系列合计激活112万多台，Pro Max单款就超过76万台。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/12/origin_6233492_4874462.jpg
图片来源：微博 @数码闲聊站
虽然大伙都在说18 Pro更新幅度不够大，还涨价，但掏钱的动作还是很诚实的。
只能说，随着安卓集体涨价“我都花大几千了？为啥不买苹果？”的魔咒，还在发力。

news.title: Gears of War: E-Day Dev Confirms DDoS Attack
news.summary: Gears of War: E-Day suffered a DDoS attack over the weekend, developer The Coalition has said.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/12/gears-1791797492273.jpg
Gears of War: E-Day suffered a DDoS attack over the weekend, developer The Coalition has said.

Players suffered intermittent disconnects and login issues while trying to play the Xbox Series X and S and PC action game, which The Coalition eventually got on top of. It has now confirmed the problems were the result of a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack targeting online services.
“Our teams are continuing to monitor and mitigate this activity. We’ll provide updates if there are any significant changes,” The Coalition said . “Thank you for your patience and understanding.”

There is a great deal of speculation online about the motivation behind hitting Gears with a DDoS attack, with some pointing to a continued online vendetta against the game for apparently being “woke.” E-Day has a “mostly positive” user review rating on Steam. Whatever the reason (there may be no overarching reason behind the DDoS attack at all), E-Day is now up and running.

Last week, Alinea Analytics' head of marketing analysis, Rhys Elliott, reported that E-Day had sold an estimated 230,000 copies in its first week in what was described as a soft start. These unofficial figures, which are not backed by data provided by Microsoft, pointed to Xbox subscription service Game Pass as cannibalizing sales.

Earlier this month, the boss of The Coalition responded to reports that staff at the studio were worried they might lose their jobs amid the ongoing cuts at Xbox, promising the next Gears game wouldn’t take as long to make.

Eurogamer had reported on internal concern that layoffs would hit The Coalition after the release of E-Day. "The mood is certainly 'let's not celebrate the game until we're three months post launch, just in case,' which is very unusual," one source told the site. "We're just expecting the next wave [of layoffs], or being reorganized under Activision or something later this year," claimed another.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business has seen nearly 2,000 people cut already this financial year, with more to come. A number of studios have left the business or are in the process of closing down. Microsoft has also reorganized its studios, bringing Halo and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under Call of Duty developer Activision, and Grounded developer Obsidian under Fallout developer Bethesda.

Of course, Gears of War: E-Day was selected to be an Xbox Series X and S and PC game, ditching any release for a sales-boosting PS5 version. The Coalition studio head Mike Crump recently told the BBC that success for E-Day goes behind sales, saying: "We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to its limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? ...Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware.”

news.title: 奥迪全系买一赠一?贺郑钦文夺冠 上汽奥迪:同款车模
news.summary: 快科技10月12日消息，据报道，2026年中国网球公开赛女单决赛中，郑钦文2-0战胜安德列娃夺冠，成为中网首位本土女单冠军。夺冠当晚，…

content.v: 快科技10月12日消息，据报道，2026年中国网球公开赛女单决赛中，郑钦文2-0战胜安德列娃夺冠，成为中网首位本土女单冠军。夺冠当晚，上汽奥迪官方账号便发布了一篇祝贺文章，标题写着“祝贺钦文夺冠！AUDI全系买一赠一”。
只是仔细一看，这场“买一赠一”和大众想象中的并不相同。所谓的赠品其实是一台同款车模，标题里的“全系”，也并非奥迪全系车型，而是仅限“AUDI”字母标电动子品牌旗下的两款车型。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121713323306.png
对此，上汽奥迪官方销售人员回应称，用户购买 E7X 或 E5 两款电动车，在月底前完成订车提车，即随车获赠对应车型的同款车模，车模价值约在千元以内，还可参与抽盲盒，活动一直持续到月底。
后续，上汽奥迪官方客服又回应称：“活动是在10月1日至10月31日之前，购买了奥迪的E5或者E7X车型，赠送的是对应车型的车模。而标题中的AUDI全系，并非Audi（奥迪英文名）的全系，AUDI并不针对于四环，只针对于字母标的一个全系。”
但标题传达出的“买一辆车送一辆车”的信息，与实际赠品存在明显落差，也让奥迪的这次宣传引发热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121713418724.png
有法律界人士分析认为，依照《广告法》第八条第二款，广告中表明附带赠送的，应当明示所附带赠送商品的品种、规格、数量、期限和方式。
该推文以“全系买一赠一”为核心卖点，正文才以小字注明赠品为车模，且活动仅限两款车型，涉嫌违反上述明示义务；若足以使消费者产生误解，还可能构成虚假广告情形。不过，是否构成违法，仍需由市场监督管理部门依法调查认定。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121713508139.png

news.title: 胡歌吐槽《仙剑3》戏很幼稚没意义 童年神剧太无聊？
news.summary: 近日，胡歌在接受采访时坦言，自己拍《仙剑奇侠传3》时觉得“戏很幼稚”“没意义”

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121710258840.png
编辑观点： 《仙剑奇侠传3》确实存在不少问题， 但放在2009年的时代背景下，是成熟的商业仙侠作品，群像塑造出彩，多条人物感情线至今被观众铭记，不能拿当下审美去全盘否定十几年前作品。喜剧只是外壳，用来平衡悲剧基调；闹剧是类型题材的表达方式，不等于剧情幼稚，它的成功证明这套叙事可以打动大量观众。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121710369476.png
近日，胡歌在接受采访时坦言，自己拍《仙剑奇侠传3》时觉得“戏很幼稚”“没意义”。这番言论迅速引发网友热议，有人认同他的说法，认为以现在的眼光看确实有很多槽点；也有人反驳，认为他在否定自己的代表作，甚至质疑“没有仙剑3，谁认识你”。
《仙剑奇侠传3》被批 前期大量无厘头搞笑桥段，部分桥段闹剧化；整体剧本存在不少逻辑漏洞，比如邪剑仙战力崩坏、茂茂割肉等情节，用现在的标准看设计比较套路化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121710443332.png
大量改编游戏原作，部分人物人设改动浮夸，重楼被削弱、角色工具人化，不少冲突依靠狗血误会推动，戏剧手法偏偶像剧套路。拍摄大量绿幕无实物表演，台词、表演模式偏向偶像剧，内核表达浅，更多聚焦爱恨情仇，缺少更深层现实向的表达，站在严肃表演视角会觉得空洞。
有观众认同胡歌的说法，认为“仙剑3确实有不少尴尬桥段，胡歌自己演的时候有这种感觉很正常”“邪剑仙战力崩坏、狗血误会推动剧情，放到现在看确实套路”。另一派则认为“拿现在的标准去评价当年的作品不公平”“2009年的仙侠剧就是这个风格，它承载了一代人的童年记忆”“喜剧外壳平衡悲剧内核，闹剧不等于幼稚，能打动观众就是好作品”。也有网友指出，胡歌的吐槽更像是对自己表演的反思，而不是在否定整部剧。
对于观众来说，它是不是神剧，跟演员怎么看无关，跟你在那个夏天有没有被它打动过有关。

news.title: 年轻人第一辆宝马再见 宝马前驱车型将全面退出中国
news.summary: 近日，宝马集团董事长聂科维（Milan Nedeljkovic）对外确认，宝马将在中国市场彻底退出UKL小型与紧凑型车型细分赛道。

content.v: 据东方财经报道，近日，宝马集团董事长聂科维（Milan Nedeljkovic）对外确认，宝马将在中国市场彻底退出UKL小型与紧凑型车型细分赛道。这也是宝马针对中国市场推出的规模最大的一次区域产品线调整。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_13/1103.jpg
据悉，UKL就是国内车迷口中的宝马前驱平台，横置前驱布局，主打低成本和大空间。基于该平台，宝马曾推出1系三厢、2系旅行车、2系四门轿跑、X1、X2等多款产品。
此次退场还不只涉及普通版车型，M Performance序列中仅有的两款国产紧凑级产品X1 M35Li与M235L，也将一同退出中国市场。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261012_zy_red_164_13/1256.jpg
此外，砍掉UKL产品线，与宝马在华的整体转向一脉相承，宝马一季度在华纯电车型销量占比仅6.6%，远低于欧洲市场的25.3%，转型压力巨大。
集团正把筹码全压在新世代平台上，沈阳基地累计投入已达1160亿元，新世代iX3、新世代i3均已在华亮相，预计四季度开启交付，到2027年底前将有40款新车和改款搭载新世代技术。

news.title: 忠诚！曝传奇AD Deft服满兵役后将复出：太爱LOL了
news.summary: 忠诚！曝传奇AD Deft服满兵役后复出：太爱LOL了

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121658282940.jpg
据电竞媒体Sheep Esports报道，2022年《英雄联盟》全球总决赛冠军ADC选手Deft（金赫奎）预计将在结束兵役后，于2027赛季加盟LCK战队NS。消息来自熟悉韩国赛区情况的消息人士，目前双方尚未正式官宣，因此具体情况仍有待确认。
Deft自2024年底以来基本淡出了职业赛场，但他并未放弃复出计划。今年2月，Deft的一名前队友就曾透露，他仍然希望重返LCK，并没有正式退役。近期，Deft重新投入韩服排位训练，并在本周打上最强王者段位，常用英雄包括伊泽瑞尔、卡莎，也在练习2025年推出的新英雄芸阿娜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121659208257.jpg
报道称，除了NS，至少还有两支LCK队伍曾考虑引进Deft，其中包括DRX。作为2013年出道的老将，Deft职业生涯曾获得2015年季中冠军赛冠军，并在2022年带领DRX一路逆袭，最终击败T1夺得全球总决赛冠军，成为英雄联盟电竞史上极具代表性的选手之一。
如果Deft最终加盟NS，队内年轻ADC选手Diable可能需要另寻下家。年仅18岁的Diable此前效力于BNK FEARX，曾帮助队伍获得LCK杯赛亚军并参加国际赛事，之后转会NS，但队伍表现不佳也影响了他的职业发展。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121659283940.jpg
外网粉丝得知消息后也纷纷表示：他太爱这个游戏了！不可思议！
